title: JA Morgan wp7: toggle, touch menu, drawer, registration, footers, social icons, overflow, tag filters, carousel arrows, back-to-top, account links behave like the source
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-morgan theme under test (local stand from the quickstart pack) and the Joomla source (local stand from quickstart/ja-morgan/j6).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node tasks/ja-morgan-wp7/tools/measure115.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --out <dir> --wp '<wp-cli prefix for the site>' (add --zip <theme.zip> --record <BROWSER.json> to bind the run to the theme bytes).
S3: Read the TOTAL line and each PASS/FAIL line.
expect: toggle: the first click on the theme toggle changes the page background on a light OS and on a dark OS (390, 768 and 1440).
touch-nav: at 1024 and 1180 with touch, the first tap on a parent menu item opens its submenu and keeps the URL; the second tap navigates.
registration: the registration form creates a subscriber account.
nav-lit, drawer-dark, drawer-close, footer, social, overflow, filters, carousel, backtop, wording, contact: each PASS with an empty bad list.
evidence: Independent audit 03/10/2026; measure115 14/14 on 1.1.5 bound to wp-ja-morgan-1.1.5.zip ac4f8daa (tasks/ja-morgan-wp7/release/BROWSER.json)
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; the tool fails closed on a crash
